factorized_runtime_inputs.release_semantics: release_or_instability evidence; conservative veto candidate, not a pure safe-release equivalent

runtime_offline_separation.runtime_scheduler_inputs: Only the causal Factorized runtime inputs listed above
runtime_offline_separation.offline_calibration_inputs: Per-head targets and known masks for independent calibrator fitting only
runtime_offline_separation.offline_policy_selection_inputs: Strict-K10 labels joined after real-adapter replay for threshold selection only
runtime_offline_separation.offline_evaluation_inputs: Strict-K10 labels and Teacher event metadata for final audit only
runtime_offline_separation.forbidden_crossover: Offline labels must never affect scheduler state transitions

episode_classification.positive: at least one VALID_START in the eligible domain
episode_classification.negative: all eligible positions are known and strict_k10_feasible=false for all
episode_classification.unknown: at least one eligible position is unknown and no known positive exists
episode_classification.no_coverage_heuristic: No arbitrary partial-known threshold is permitted

k10_corridor.definition: Any VALID_START is a legal scheduler emission start
k10_corridor.containment: T10 containment is already encoded by strict_k10_feasible
k10_corridor.no_double_horizon: Do not require a multi-step block of feasible starts
k10_corridor.contiguous_regions: Used only for timing-offset and visualization metrics
k10_corridor.source: Offline Teacher evaluation bundle only; never a runtime gate

negative_episodes.definition: count of fully known episodes with no valid start

positive_episodes.definition: count of episodes with at least one valid start

unknown_episodes.definition: count of episodes whose eligible domain is not fully verifiable and has no known positive

negative_episode_emits.definition: scheduler emitted on a negative episode

positive_on_corridor_emits.definition: scheduler emitted at a valid start on a positive episode

positive_off_corridor_emits.definition: scheduler emitted outside all valid starts on a positive episode

positive_abstentions.definition: scheduler did not emit on a positive episode

unknown_episode_emits.definition: scheduler emitted on an unknown episode; reported separately

median_timing_offset.definition: median of emit_step minus the start of the containing valid-start region

region_length.definition: number of valid starts in the containing contiguous region

calibration.fit_data: canonical calibration_records.jsonl raw logits, targets and known masks
calibration.probability_audit: recorded probability must match sigmoid(raw_logit) within the frozen tolerance

provenance.INDEPENDENT_CALIBRATION: fit identities were not used in checkpoint training
provenance.TRAIN_RESUBSTITUTION_CALIBRATION: fit identities were used in checkpoint training and are diagnostic-only

execution_boundary.authoritative_l3: requires sealed independent fit, policy-selection and heldout evaluation artifacts
